prompt:
Workflow step: Use the fixed robot arm to pick up the test tube from tray and move it to capping device to screw on the test tube cap.
Inspection timing: after this step
Inspection location: capping device
What the inspection checks: Check near capping device whether the test tube on the gripper has been screwed on.

The inspection camera's photograph is attached.
observations: The image shows the robot arm at the capping station with an orange/red object (likely a cap or vial) held in the capping fixture, but the test tube and gripper are largely occluded by the green board and the robot arm itself, so it is not possible to see whether a cap has been screwed onto the tube.
